children: Autonomix Medical appointed Sandra Kalter as an independent member of its Board, effective immediately.
Independent member of the Board (non-employee director)
Board increased size from five to six members and appointed Ms. Kalter as an independent director

Former Chief Regulatory Counsel & VP at Medtronic (May 2011–Jan 2025); Strategic Advisor to iTolerance (Nov 2025–Apr 2026); board/committee experience at AdvaMed, Food and Drug Law Institute, Breakthrough T1D; JD George Washington Univ.; BSJ Northwestern Univ.
Has not been appointed to any Board committees at this time
